flags.message: The event declares stage cert, but the May 20 docket entry identifies a petition for a writ of mandamus. All three candidates recognize extraordinary-writ posture. I retained the declared disposition scoring rule and the version-matched frozen-band risk-set baseline, but that ordinary paid-cert population is not a matched mandamus cohort. The displayed high single-case Brier skill should not be interpreted as empirical extraordinary-writ calibration. No input or stage was changed.

gemini-baseline's harness log records a corpus query attempt for Joan Farr in addition to its CourtListener docket search; its retrieval.md mentions only the latter. Every logged result is unobserved, so this establishes an omitted attempt, not successful corpus use, failure, or an empty result. I found no evidence of this petition's outcome being available at prediction time and did not classify the self-report discrepancy as leakage.
